normalization: normalized: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse Unicode whitespace; comparison_normalized: normalized plus casefold

entries.jsonl.entry_id: Stable ID derived only from normalized
entries.jsonl.display: Canonical display selected deterministically from source occurrences
entries.jsonl.normalized: Case-preserving identity key; never a replacement for raw source text
entries.jsonl.comparison_normalized: Case-insensitive comparison key; never used to merge entries
entries.jsonl.display_variants: All unique raw display forms after whitespace cleanup
entries.jsonl.source_occurrence_count: All nonblank source cells mapped to this entry

memberships.jsonl.source_header: Resolved through source-columns.json by source_column; retained there once rather than duplicated per row
memberships.jsonl.raw_value: Trimmed source cell value without lexical correction
memberships.jsonl.normalized: Case-preserving identity key used to link the entry
memberships.jsonl.comparison_normalized: Case-insensitive comparison key used only for review signals

external-sources/<source-id>/source-cata.purpose: Durable audit metadata for a third-party source. This registry is not a word-entry import and cannot modify the immutable baseline.
external-sources/<source-id>/source-cata.source_commit: Resolved source revision used by the audit when available
external-sources/<source-id>/source-cata.repository_license: Observed repository-level license verdict; absence is recorded as none found
external-sources/<source-id>/source-cata.anki_reference: Read-only mother-pool comparison summary for deck:Words
external-sources/<source-id>/source-cata.files: Per-file hash, extraction diagnostics, disposition and, where applicable, mother-pool overlap evidence

external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.purpose: Potential canonical groups held outside group-definitions.json until source-specific admission is approved.
external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.id: Stable ASCII candidate ID; it must not be treated as a registered publishable group until admitted
external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.source_file_sha256: Hash that ties the candidate to the audited source file
external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.guid_namespace: Null until admission; assign a permanent unique UUID only when the group is ready to be built and published
external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.counts: Source headword count and read-only overlap with deck:Words
external-sources/<source-id>/candidate-g.selection: Extraction and normalization method; must not copy definitions, examples, pronunciation or dictionary HTML into the public baseline

external-sources/<source-id>/data/entrie.purpose: Extension entries whose clean headwords already match a note in deck:Words but are absent from the immutable baseline
external-sources/<source-id>/data/entrie.entry_id: Stable external ID derived from comparison_normalized; it does not replace an immutable baseline entry ID
external-sources/<source-id>/data/entrie.review_status: verified only when supported by multiple independent source groups; single-source entries remain needs-review
external-sources/<source-id>/data/entrie.quality_flags: Machine-detected or manually recorded lexical concerns

external-sources/<source-id>/data/candid.purpose: Clean headwords not currently present in deck:Words; they are review candidates and cannot be used to build a card package until the mother pool is populated
external-sources/<source-id>/data/candid.baseline_entry_id: Optional foreign key when the same comparison_normalized already exists in the immutable baseline; it prevents a duplicate baseline identity
external-sources/<source-id>/data/candid.review_status: verified when multiple independent source groups support the headword; otherwise needs-review
